name: @nanoneuron/web

scripts.build: echo 'no JS build needed for this FastAPI backend'

description: This is a FastAPI/Python backend with no real JS build. This file exists because this Vercel team enforces both an Install Command (`bun install --frozen-lockfile`) AND a Build Command (`bun run --filter @nanoneuron/web build`) on every project, unconditionally -- confirmed by real failed deploys, not overridable via project settings or vercel.json's `framework` field. The name and build script here exist purely to satisfy that enforced filter as a no-op; the real Python dependency install and app startup are handled separately by Vercel's FastAPI framework preset (see apps/api/vercel.json).
